lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits, following the curvature of the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a localized grid-like arrangement across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High density of smaller, more uniform high-luminance clusters on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
